d: A woman Marine recruit dies at Parris Island. Harm investigates while Meg poses undercover as a recruit.
During a landing exercise Marines find a beaten, comatose fellow Marine on the beach
By mistake a foreign agent sends a fax to Meg's office; then he retrieves it and shoots Meg to prevent her from identifying him
A Marine sniper receives orders contrary to a previous deal; his CO refuses to listen; the sniper takes a shot at the CO's Humvee.
After a lightning strike, an F-14 wanders into Cuban airspace, and Cuban fighters force it to land
A Naval aviator, while temporarily assigned to a SEAL team, drowns at sea; he was the son of a woman senator.
In a civilian court Harm represents a divorced (and emotionally baffled) Marine colonel, who has gotten into trouble over an unauthorized visit with his minor son.
A Navy astronaut dies during a drill while preparing for a space mission to repair a satellite
Chicom agents capture Harm in Hong Kong; they vigorously question him in mainland China about official matters.
Someone kills a Naval officer on Okinawa, then his ship encounters major trouble during war games at sea
The body of a woman Naval officer, a friend, and classmate of Harm, is found ashore.

Harm and his new partner, Marine Major Sara MacKenzie are drawn into a game of revenge when they're sent to Belfast, Ireland, to represent the legal interests of a Navy Lieutenant whose infant son has seemingly been abducted.
Admiral Chegwidden, Mac and Bud Roberts are taken hostage in the Admiral's office by Pvt. Magida, a Marine who escaped from a nearby Federal prison.
Harm and Mac investigate an attempt on Admiral Chedwiggen's life and uncover the fact that all the members of his former SEAL team have died under mysterious circumstances.
While on their day off, Harm takes Mac for a flight in his vintage airplane, only to be forced to make an emergency landing in a mountain clearing because of mechanical problems.
Harm, Mac, and Bud are assigned sea duty to monitor a joint war games exercise between U.S. and Russian naval forces.
Harm and Mac defend Bauwer, a former Navy Seal, now a homeless man, who's accused of using excessive force when he killed three men who tried to hold up a convenience store.
Mac and Harm once again find themselves courtroom adversaries as Mac is assigned the difficult task of defending CPO Holst, an admitted wife abuser accused of murdering his wife's boyfriend.

Harm and Mac investigate the discovery of a skeleton found hidden aboard a decommissioned aircraft carrier that is being cut up for scrap, and learn it is all that remains of a long-missing JAG officer.
